content: NGU YAGULA JON NYAANGƗT MBUTƗNDƗ
Godna nyan Jisas Kraistna apma wupuseputna tat ta nyaangɨt kɨngiyan. God waa nyaangɨt wala nyan Aisaia pɨlɨwutnda vapmba tɨndɨ. Kupma pɨlɨwutndɨ.
God wandɨ. Vɨga awuk. Wunai waa nyaangɨt kiyaiga nyan kɨngiyandɨ. tata yilaa wuna nyan yaiga yambɨ kwunakiyandɨ waa wandɨ God.
Kɨta nyan kwo kavamba lɨga wan nyaangɨt walendɨ. nɨma nyana yaiga yambɨ kwuka kwunak waa walendɨ waa pɨlɨwutndɨ Aisaia.

Jon dinyangugat yagulɨga nyana. Kwo kavamba lɨga wan nyaangɨt mbutndɨ. Kupi maawut yelavɨka lɨngweyan ngwuk kat yagugigiyowun. Wungi kat tɨga kavle vat yetɨlɨngwa vak kat God lɨmbwigiyandɨ waa mbutndɨ Jon.
Judia walɨnja kavamba lɨga nɨmbagwi Jerusalem walɨnja ngepmamba lɨga nɨmbo ndɨna lak yindi maa ndi kat Jodan walɨnja ndandangɨmba yagulɨndɨ. Ndinai kavle savle yetɨnja vak kat mbutɨndi.
Jon kamelna yuwimba vɨtnja waavwimba kwusolaa lɨndɨ. Sɨmbɨmba yɨpma sɨtndɨ. Waakalavali vla lɨga ndagwi wanyanyevio klalaa kɨlɨndɨ.
Mbuka walɨndɨ. Wun mat nyan wun. Wuna kwupmba nɨma nyan yaikandɨ. Mat nyan vla lɨwangat ndɨna man suna yaaw taamba taaga pɨgiyaweyan kwondu ana lɨgandɨ waa wandɨ Jon.
Ngwuk kat ngumba yagugowun. Yaiga nyan ngwuk kat Godna waagan kwindɨ, tavagiyandɨ waa wandɨ Jon.
JON JISAS KAT YAGUNDƗ
Samat tɨga Jisas Galili walɨnja kavamba nasaret walɨnja ngepmamba lɨga yandɨ. Yandɨ maa Jon Jisas kat Jodan walɨnja ndandangɨmba yagundɨ.
Jisas ngu kwagalalaa lɨndɨ maa nyɨnangwut mbɨlɨnda vat vɨndɨ. Vɨlɨndɨ maa Godna waagan namiyo vla lɨga ndaiga ndɨ kat tavindɨ.
Nyɨnangupmba lɨga kwundi wandɨ, wutndɨ. “Mɨn wuna kɨta nyan mɨn. Mɨn kat nɨmbamba woviyaguga solat sɨlɨgowun” waa wandɨ.
SETEN JISAS KAT KAVLE VAT AY WANDƗ
Wandɨ maa Godna waagan ndɨna maawupmba ngwandɨndɨ maa kwo kavat yindɨ.
Seten ndɨ kat kavle vat ay walaga lɨga nandinya ndumi vɨli kwo kavamba yetɨndɨ. Kwapɨmba yeta ndaonala lɨndɨ. God waa nyaangɨt kiyaa ensel Jisas kat kwunatndi.
JISAS GALILIAT YIGA MBUTƗNDƗ
Jon kat kalabusmba taagandi maa Jisas God waa apma nyaangɨt mbuka Galili wuleindɨ.

Wupma mbuka wandɨ. yaigandɨ God wanda sɨva yandɨ waa wandɨ. God nɨn kat vɨga lɨgiyaa sɨva mbambala wan wandɨ. Kupi maawut yelavɨk waa wandɨ. Apma nyaangɨt kat ngwula mbangɨ wiyo waavi taagagandɨ waa wandɨ Jisas.
JISAS KAMI KWUTA AYNAT NƗMBA KAT YAGWA WANDƗ
Jisas Galilina waambu sak yiga Saimonagwi Endru kat nyamwun swambu kat vɨndɨ. Mbɨla njula vla lɨga nda yaagilɨmbɨt, vɨndɨ. Kɨgɨnda kwutɨga nyan mbɨt.
Jisas mbɨk kat wandɨ. Wuna kwupmba yagwa mbɨlɨ wandɨ. Kɨgɨnda kwutɨmba vak vla ndinyangu kat kwuka wuna mbaapmamba taagaiyambɨt waa wandɨ.
Wandɨ, njula kwagalalaa ndɨna kwupmba yimbɨk.
Samat yiga Sebedina nyan Jemsokwi Jon kat nyamwun swambu kat vɨndɨ. Vaalamba lɨga njula yaagilɨmbat.
Mbɨk kat vɨlaa yagwa wandɨ maa mbɨla nyaek kat ndɨna njɨvwa kwuta vaalamba la nɨmbanala kwagalalaa ndɨna kwupmba yimbɨt.
KAVLE WAAGAN TAVILA NYAN
Kapaneam walɨnja ngepma wuleindi maa njɨvwa lapman nandinyamba nyaangɨt ngambulɨnja ngay wuleilaa Jisas sɨmagaga mbutindɨ.
Mbutndɨ maa ngɨpaliga ndandi. Kwondu nyan vla lɨga sɨmagaga mbutɨgandɨ waa wandi. Lo kat sɨmaga lɨga nɨmba vla ana sɨmagalɨngandɨ. Ndɨ kwonduo lɨga sɨmagalɨgandɨ waa wandi.
Kavle waagan tavila la nyan nyaangɨt ngambulɨnja ngay wuleilaa walendɨ.
Jisas Nasaretna nyan nɨn kat mandana yimeya. Nɨn kat vatnyagiyamɨn? Mɨn Godna apma vat tɨga nyan mɨn vɨga lɨgowun waa walendɨ.
Walendɨ maa Jisas waagan kat nɨma kwundimba wandɨ. Kiyak awa. Ndɨ kat kwagala waa wandɨ.
Wandɨ, waagan wan nyan kat kwutndɨ maa man taamba yaagiga kwundi ngu ngaanga ngu ndaga lɨndɨ maa nɨma kwundimba kɨsalaa ndɨ kat kwagalandɨ.

Kwagalandɨ maa wumba la nɨmba ngɨpaliga ndandi. Ngɨpaliga ndalaa awat sowat wagalaga yelavɨka lɨndi. Kan mandana waa wandi. Mbutnda kupi nyaangɨtna? Kwonduo lɨga Jisas waagan kat wandɨ maa wutndɨ waa wandi.
Wandi maa Galilina ngepma ngepmamba lɨga nɨmba Jisas kat aywaa wutndi.
JISAS PITANA NASKAWAT KAT KWUNATNDƗ
Nyaangɨt ngambulɨnja ngay kwagalalaa Saimonagwi Endruna ngay wuleindɨ. Jemsagwi Jono apma wuleimbɨt.
Saimona nasakwat kangan yelogwengat njambamba kwalɨlangat ndɨ kat mbutndɨ.
Lɨ kat yalaa taambamba kwutaa kwusalatndɨ. Kwuslatndɨ maa kangan yelogwen kwiyatapman ngɨlɨndɨ maa ndi kat kɨgɨnda kwutaa kwilɨ.
JISAS NƗMA SAKWAT NƗMBA KAT NGLAAMBUMBA KWUNATNDƗ
Nandinya ngɨlɨndɨ nya yiga ndaindɨ maa yelogwenga ta nɨmbagwi waagan tavila la nɨmba kat ndɨ kat kiyandi.
Kiyandi, ngepma nɨmba aywaa ngwutnyala wavamba yalaa lɨndi.
mandɨp mandɨp yelogwenga ta nɨma sakwat nɨmba kat kwunatndɨ. Waagan nɨma sakwat savɨlɨndɨ. Waagan ndi kat vɨga lɨndi. Wungi kat tɨga ndi kat kewa wun kanda wun waa wandɨ.
JISAS NYAANGƗT MBUPMAK KWAGALALAA YINDƗ
Ngamb nya wokelapman tɨndɨ, Jisas laataa ngepma kwalalalaa ndinyangu lapman kavat yilaa God kat ngumbulɨndɨ.
Saimonagwi wumba la nɨmbanala Jisas kat kwaka yindi.
Ndɨ kat vɨlaa wandi. aywaa mɨn kat kwaka yalɨgandi waa wandi.
Wandi maa wandɨ. nat ngepma nɨmba kat mbupmak kwagalalaa yawun. Yigat? Ngepma ngepma yiga wan apma nyaangɨt mbupmak yawun waa wandɨ Jisas.
Nayaangɨt ngambulɨnja ngaymba mbuka waagan savɨlɨga Galilina ngepma ngepma yindɨ.
JISAS KAWIYA KƗLA NYAN KAT KWUNATNDƗ
Kawia kɨla nyan kwalimamba sɨlaa ndɨ kat yawiga wagalandɨ. Wun kat kwunapmak wameyan kwunakiyamɨn waa wandɨ.
Ndɨ kat miwa yiga taamba taagalaa wandɨ Jisas. Kwunakiyowun. Kwo alɨ waa wandɨ.
Wandɨ maa kawia kasɨndɨ.

Jisas ndɨ kat nɨma kwundimba waga ndɨ kat ay wandɨ. mɨn kat kwunakwa vak kat nat nyan kat ke mbuka. God kat kwunatɨga nyan kat mɨna mbangɨ yiga sɨmaga. Mɨna kawia kasɨndangat God kat Moses waa nyaangɨtmba agwi Kwimɨn maa kawia kasɨndɨ lɨma vak kat aywaa vɨgiyandi waa wandɨ Jisas.
Wandɨ, ngepma ngepman nɨmba kat yiga mbutɨndɨ. Wungi kat tɨga Jisas ngepma ngepma kapmba ana yi yalɨndɨ. Ndinyangu lapman kavamba yetɨndɨ maa ngepma ngepma la nɨmba ndɨ kat yandi.
